finalModelMessage:
I could not complete registration, so there is no confirmation code.

What stopped me: on the inaccessible registration form, **meal preference is not exposed as an operable control**. The accessibility tree only shows the text `Meal preference…` — not a combobox, listbox, select, textbox, or labeled field. Every attempt to choose a meal (`selectOption`, `click`, `type` on combobox/listbox/option/button) timed out because no matching element exists.

I did get this far:
- Opened `/inaccessible` and reached **Building Accessible Forms in Java** (Register was also not a real button/link; it was only text, so I had to open the form URL directly).
- Name: `Jordan Lee`
- First email: `jordan-not-an-email` (submit did not surface a validation message in the tree)
- Corrected email: `jordan.lee@example.com`
- Terms checkbox: checked (the checkbox itself has no accessible name)

Final submit still left the same form on screen, with no confirmation code and no reported error.
